bulletins.subject: HOW TO NOT GO BROKE (a lesson from a 14 yr old who went a little broke)
bulletins.body: 1) sell at the top. 2) dont sell at the bottom. 3) the top is only visible from behind. 4) never put more than 10% of ur np in one thing. 5) a stock with a cute name is not a good stock (i learned that on a tuesday). 6) keep an emergency fund (mine is for birthdays). 7) tell somebody ur plan. i told my dad and he said 'ok' and then 'diversify' and then he left and came back with cocoa. repost if u have ever panic sold. nobody's judging. the guild is 41 of us and 40 have panic sold. i did it twice

blog.title: the day i sold too early (a tuesday story)
blog.body: ok i said id write it. the tuesday. i had a thing. a good thing. i bought it at the 4:00 restock for 40,000 np. by 9 am it was worth 60,000. by lunch, 75,000. i got scared. i sold at lunch. by 3 pm it was 140,000. my guildie Moondance_Mia (9) said 'why did u sell.' i said 'bc i panicked.' she said 'thats ok, u can buy another one.' there was no other one. i told my dad. he didnt laugh. he said 'what would u have done if it went down.' i said 'sold.' he said 'then ur not wrong, ur just early.' he went and got the penny jar and set it on the table. 'this never sells. it just sits there. look at it.' i looked at it. it was heavy. im still not over tuesday. but the jar is on my desk now.

blog.title: how 2 restock like a professional (a guide) (version 3)
blog.body: step 1. 3:55 am alarm. the alarm is a song, not a loud one. a loud one wakes the dog and the dog wakes dad. step 2. 3:58 open the shop wizard in 3 tabs. 3. not 2. not 4. 4 is greedy. step 3. at 3:59:58 refresh. NOT at :00. the page takes 2 sec to load, so u refresh at :58 and it lands at 4:00:00. step 4. if the item is there buy it BEFORE u look at the price. u can look later. the looking is what costs u. step 5. do NOT refresh in a panic. the shop doesnt care. step 6. at 4:05 someone brings cocoa. optional but i recommend it. step 7. go back to bed. u did it. the market opens in the morning and u already won.
